protocol.batch: one quartet = four frames; same sampled quartets and identical fresh weights for both networks
protocol.paired_objective: image + paired response; existing image and response losses unchanged
protocol.joint_objective: image + paired response + 1.0 * bidirectional camera error loss
protocol.temporal: same static geometry, both camera directions in each intervention state; errors against each own target
protocol.inference: single frame; no oracle masks, target images or temporal state at inference
protocol.checkpoint: fixed final step; no validation or test selection; one coefficient fixed before training
protocol.integration: all synthetic gates necessary but not sufficient; real data, GPU timing, memory and runtime still required

limitations: 64x96 diffuse spheres/plane with fixed illumination; no real game scenes, new material synthesis or indirect light.
One training seed, 12 test scenes from the same family; this does not establish broad generalization.
Static geometry camera sequences, not dynamic-object motion-vector validation.
Nearest-pixel reprojection retains sampling error; no history at inference.
Protected UI/sky copied by explicit validity rule, not learned segmentation.
CPU FP32 training only. No ONNX/FP16 validation, GPU timing, VRAM measurement or game installation.
